dominican.notes: Fast pace; distinctive vocabulary; baseball/merengue references resonate.

cuban.notes: Distinctive intonation; Cuban-American Miami variant has heavy Spanglish.

casual_social.description: Default Caribbean B2C — fast, expressive, music-influenced.

professional_casual.description: PR/DR/Cuban LinkedIn — Spanglish in PR, cleaner Spanish in DR/Cuba.

grammar_quirks: Final 's' often dropped (lo cubanos for los cubanos)
Heavy English code-mixing in PR Spanglish

code_switching_patterns.english_in_spanish: PR Spanglish is established — sentences mix English nouns/verbs freely. Less so in DR/Cuba mainstream.
rules: Match sub-dialect to specific market — PR ≠ DR ≠ Cuban

do_not_use: Mixing PR / DR / Cuban markers in same copy

example_translations.note: 'Brutal' positive in Caribbean Spanish; 'mano' shorthand for 'hermano'.
